_readme: All site copy lives here. Every factual claim carries a `source`. Anything MGTD must supply is wrapped in [square brackets] and rendered as a visible placeholder (class .ph). Replace, then delete the brackets.

company.name: MGTD Environmental
company.tagline: High-quality, turnkey, strategic environmental consulting services.
company.summary: MGTD Environmental offers high-quality, turnkey, strategic environmental consulting services aimed at addressing complex environmental challenges faced by the business community.
company.vision: To be the preferred environmental firm for our clients, delivering global services that align with their business goals.
company.mission: To deliver effective environmental consulting that supports clients in achieving their objectives, with strategic solutions that also consider the needs of other stakeholders.
sources: mgtdenvironmental.co.za (page title and description, as indexed by search engines)
ZoomInfo company profile for MGTD Environmental (quotes the company's vision and mission)
company._note: Vision and mission are reconstructed from indexed summaries of the site because the live site could not be fetched from the build environment. Paste the exact wording from mgtdenvironmental.co.za.

contact.areaSource: Fourways Review (March 2014) refers to 'the MGTD Environmental offices in Cresta'. Confirm this is still current.
contact._formEndpoint: Set to a URL that accepts a JSON POST (Formspree, a CRM webhook, etc.). While null, a valid form opens a pre-filled email if `email` is set, otherwise it reports that the form is not yet connected.

services.title: Strategic Environmental Consulting
services.summary: Environmental advice framed around the client's business goals, so that environmental decisions support what the business is trying to achieve.
points: Considers the needs of other stakeholders
services.source: Company positioning: 'strategic environmental consulting services', vision of 'global services that align with their business goals'.

services.title: Turnkey Environmental Solutions
services.summary: One consultant carrying the environmental component of a project from first question to finished deliverable, rather than a series of disconnected appointments.
services.source: Company positioning: 'high-quality, turnkey, strategic environmental consulting services'.

services.title: Environmental Assessment
services.summary: Assessment of proposed development and infrastructure, including the Basic Assessment process for proposed bulk water and sewer pipelines between Cosmo City and Lanseria.
services.source: Fourways Review, 7 March 2014: a background information document and draft basic assessment report were available from MGTD Environmental.

services.title: Public Participation
services.summary: Informing the public and interested and affected parties about a proposed project, gathering their comments and explaining the environmental assessment process.
services.source: Fourways Review, 7 March 2014: public meetings at Thabo Mbeki Village and Das Landhaus Guestlodge; comments invited until 19 April.

projects.name: Cosmo City to Lanseria bulk water and sewer pipelines
projects.location: Cosmo City to Lanseria, north-west Johannesburg, Gauteng. The upgrades also affect the Lion Park and Farmall areas.
projects.type: Linear infrastructure: proposed new bulk water pipelines, sewer pipelines and associated infrastructure
projects.role: Environmental assessment. The background information document and the draft Basic Assessment Report were available from MGTD Environmental, and the public was invited to meetings and to comment.
projects.context: A proposed service corridor through the peri-urban edge of northern Johannesburg, where new bulk infrastructure meets existing settlements, farmland and open veld.
